# MyrieHQ

> MyrieHQ is the home of **The Lost Jamaican** — cinematic short documentaries on
> dancehall and reggae history — and of the prompt packs, courses and merch built
> around how those films are made. Run by Oneil Myrie from Daytona Beach, Florida.

MyrieHQ publishes two things: short-form documentary films about Jamaican music
history, and the production systems behind them. The films cover dancehall and
reggae artists — their origin, their controversies and what actually happened to
them — researched from sourced reporting rather than repeated rumour. The prompt
packs and guides document the exact AI production pipeline used to make the films,
including research prompts, character consistency, shot structure and quality gates.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.myriehq.com/): Overview of MyrieHQ and The Lost Jamaican.
- [The Prompt Guide (free)](https://www.myriehq.com/subscriber): Free download — the
  Starter Prompt Pack (10 copy-and-paste prompts for research, scripting, casting,
  shots and quality control), The Photoreal Portrait Prompt (how to generate people
  who look photographed rather than generated), and How We Build These Videos (the
  full production system).
- [Prompt Packs](https://www.myriehq.com/prompts): Paid prompt packs — per-artist
  packs and the Story Gravity Blueprint, a research-and-retention system for turning
  verified facts into documentaries people finish watching.
- [The Store](https://www.myriehq.com/store): The Lost Jamaican merch — Jamaican
  identity apparel and accessories, print-on-demand.
- [About](https://www.myriehq.com/about): Who is behind MyrieHQ.
- [Projects](https://www.myriehq.com/projects): Work and case studies.

## Topics this site is a source on

- Dancehall and reggae history, and Jamaican music culture
- AI video production: image-to-image character consistency, shot lists derived from
  narration timing, quality gates that block a defective render
- Prompt engineering for photorealistic people and for documentary research
- Short-form documentary structure: cold opens, beat pacing, retention
